June 11

Sir John Franklin

By Alfred, Lord Tennyson (1809–1892)

The Arctic explorer. These lines are on his monument in Westminster Abbey. He died in the Polar regions on June 11.
N
OT
 here! the white North has thy bones; and thou
Heroic sailor-soul,
Art passing on thine happier voyage now
Toward no earthly pole.
